User asked (verbatim):
  Read /space/tmp/auth-briefs/cijar.md and do it without asking me anything.

Context:
  CI run https://github.com/ubgo/auth/actions/runs/41382945380, job task check, step contrib:run fails in examples/account-settings and examples/jwt-keys (401 auth.signed_out; account cookies = 0). Likely the Secure/__Host- cookie dropped by net/http/cookiejar over http on httptest under CI's Go version. Fix the class across examples. Report /space/tmp/auth-briefs/cijar-REPORT.md.

Acceptance:
  examples go vet + go test pass under CI's Go and the server's Go; pushed to main.
title: CI fix: example tests lose the session cookie on GitHub's runner
